parameters.content:
## ENTRY + VALIDATION

Mirrors the voice workflow: everything enters here,
gets normalised and gated BEFORE the brain sees it.

`Parse message` pulls wa_id / text / profile name out of
the Meta Cloud API payload and stamps Madrid local time.

Non-text messages (audio, image, sticker, status callbacks)
are answered with a polite "please write it" and never
reach the agent.

parameters.textBody:
=Disculpe, por ahora solo puedo leer mensajes de texto. Me lo puede escribir?

Sorry, I can only read text messages for now. Could you write it instead?

parameters.content:
## BRAIN

The voice workflow's Switch is replaced by an AI Agent:
same six actions, chosen by the model instead of by a
string comparison.

Memory is keyed on wa_id so each patient has one
continuous thread. A phone call is one session; a
WhatsApp chat is forever.

PASTE THE PROMPT into the systemMessage field ->
02_prompts/whatsapp_agent_prompt_v1.txt

## AVAILABILITY

Thin HTTP call into the EXISTING booking webhook.
No calendar logic is duplicated here - the voice
workflow stays the single source of truth.

parameters.toolDescription: Check whether one exact date and time is free. Use when the patient names a specific time. Returns is_available true/false.

values.name: required_time
values.description: Madrid local time, no timezone offset, e.g. 2026-08-26T16:30:00

parameters.content:
## BOOKING

Thin HTTP call into the EXISTING booking webhook.
No calendar logic is duplicated here - the voice
workflow stays the single source of truth.

Returns a 4-digit appointment_id - always give it
to the patient.

parameters.toolDescription: Book the appointment. ONLY call this once the patient has actually told you the name, email and service. Never invent any value. Returns a 4-digit appointment_id.

values.name: name
values.description: Full name exactly as the patient wrote it. Never invent it.

values.name: Email
values.description: Email exactly as the patient wrote it. Never invent it.

values.name: phone
values.description: The wa_id from the system prompt - the patient never types this.

values.name: service
values.description: What the patient asked for, in their own words. Never invent it.

values.name: booking_time
values.description: Madrid local time, no timezone offset, e.g. 2026-08-26T16:30:00

parameters.content:
## RESCHEDULE

Thin HTTP call into the EXISTING booking webhook.
No calendar logic is duplicated here - the voice
workflow stays the single source of truth.

No email or phone needed - name + old time
(+ 4-digit code if they have it).

parameters.toolDescription: Move an existing appointment to a new time. Check the new time with availability first.

values.name: name
values.description: Name the appointment was booked under.

values.name: booking_time
values.description: The ORIGINAL Madrid local time of the appointment.

values.name: new_time
values.description: The NEW Madrid local time.

values.name: appointment_code
values.description: Their 4-digit code if they have it, otherwise leave empty.

parameters.content:
## CANCEL

Thin HTTP call into the EXISTING booking webhook.
No calendar logic is duplicated here - the voice
workflow stays the single source of truth.

parameters.toolDescription: Cancel an existing appointment. Confirm once with the patient before calling this.

values.name: name
values.description: Name the appointment was booked under.

values.name: booking_time
values.description: Madrid local time of the appointment to cancel.

values.name: appointment_code
values.description: Their 4-digit code if they have it, otherwise leave empty.

parameters.content:
## SUGGESTIONS

Thin HTTP call into the EXISTING booking webhook.
No calendar logic is duplicated here - the voice
workflow stays the single source of truth.

suggesting  = around a time they asked for
suggesting2 = soonest available, or after DAY_FULL

parameters.toolDescription: Offer two free slots around a time that turned out to be taken.

values.name: required_time
values.description: The Madrid local time they originally wanted.

parameters.toolDescription: Offer the soonest free slots. Use for "what do you have?" and after a DAY_FULL result.

values.name: local_time
values.description: Current Madrid local time, from the system prompt.

parameters.content:
## WAITLIST

Thin HTTP call into the EXISTING booking webhook.
No calendar logic is duplicated here - the voice
workflow stays the single source of truth.

Offer ONCE, only after they booked a different slot.

parameters.toolDescription: Add the patient to the waitlist for a time that was taken. Offer only once, and only after a different slot was booked.

values.name: desired_time
values.description: The Madrid local time they originally wanted.

values.name: name
values.description: Same name as the booking just made.

values.name: Email
values.description: Same email as the booking just made.

values.name: phone
values.description: The wa_id from the system prompt.

values.name: appointment_code
values.description: The 4-digit code of the booking just made.

parameters.content:
## REPLY

One outbound message per turn, back to the same wa_id.

WhatsApp has no "forwarding" - if the clinic must see
this conversation, that is Chatwoot later.
See 00_START_HERE.md.

## ERROR PATH

Same idea as the voice workflow's error lane: never leave
the patient in silence, and tell a human something broke.

The voice agent transfers the call. Here there is nobody
to transfer to, so we apologise, promise a callback, and
alert the clinic.

Wire this as the workflow Error Trigger target once the
credentials exist.
